boundary_assumptions: Upstream USGS observations are applied at the nearest named mainstem entry inside a 60 m inward-buffered HUC12 polygon; no area scaling is applied.

USGS 01138500 at Wells River is upstream of the model inlet, approximately 18.70 km away in projected straight-line distance. Applying it without routing or area scaling is an illustrative approximation; intervening ungauged contributions are not invented.
Only one upstream mainstem gauge is used, so nested station catchments are not added twice.
User-approved illustrative soil constants fill only missing processed values: permeability 1e-12 m2, porosity 0.42, residual 0.08, alpha 0.0002 Pa^-1. Raw SSURGO is unchanged.
The southern named Connecticut River endpoint defines a terrain-matched 600 m outlet corridor. Channel bathymetry is not inferred or calibrated.
This is a reproducible input-preparation example, not a calibrated flood model. Four months of GPU spin-up and the full event are not executed by the notebook.
